forward.policy: positive-intensity centroid radius (3,5,5), registered translation Hungarian, minimum component length 8

reverse.policy: registered translation Hungarian, one-frame synthetic gap at 4.5 um/step with DeepCenter 0.20 gate for spans >=8.5 um and 5% cap, minimum component length 6

deployment_note: Hidden embryos are disjoint from training. The exact OOF dispatcher is available only for the two evaluated embryos; production uses a frozen label-free continuity selector when the embryo prefix is unseen.
